title: Let the status border automatically follow the text color
goal: uses currentColor to get the color value from the text color of the current element.
summary: reservation status uses green and brown respectively. Let the card borders use their own text colors, so there is no need to repeatedly update the borders when the theme changes color.
tasks: adds a 2px solid border to .badge, and uses currentColor for the border color.
retains the existing text colors in both states.

example.note: currentColor takes the color of the current element. When the child element inherits the text color, this value can also be used to draw the border.

hint: maintains unified border rules, and the text color is still set separately in the two states.
